item.title: Sales rebound in Jan as retail sees strongest rise since May ’24
item.description: The latest Office for National Statistics figures show retail sales volumes jumped 1.8 per cent in January, marking the largest monthly increase since May 2024 and offering the clearest sign yet that consumers may be regaining some confidence after a soft end to 2025. item.title: Flying Tiger appoints new CEO to bolster international growth
item.description: Flying Tiger Copenhagen has named Jens Aarup Mikkelsen as its new CEO, succeeding Martin Jermiin.

item.title: Co-op quick commerce MD Chris Conway steps down after 8 years
item.description: Co-op quick commerce managing director Chris Conway has departed from the retailer after eight years.

item.title: Debenhams Group boosts fundraise to £40m
item.description: Debenhams Group has increased its proposed fundraising to £40m, as it reportedly seeks to strengthen its balance sheet and accelerate its turnaround strategy.

item.title: Nearly half of retail staff went to work ill at the end of 2025, says report
item.description: Almost half (49%) of staff went into work while unwell at the end of 2025, up 40% from the start of the year, according to the latest Retail People Index.

item.title: Saks Global issued final approval for bankruptcy funding
item.description: Saks Global has received final approval for its $1bn bankruptcy loan after resolving payment disputes with creditors and luxury brands.

item.title: Trump imposes new 15% global tariffs on US imports
item.description: President Donald Trump has increased temporary tariffs on US imports from all countries from 10% to 15%, mere hours after the US Supreme Court declared his use of emergency tariffs a "disgrace to the nation".
